exposed_dft_features.name: Multi-Purpose Register (MPR, MR3 A2=1)
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Predefined data pattern [0,1,0,1,0,1,0,1] returned by RD/RDA — used as a built-in deterministic read training pattern accessible without valid array data.

exposed_dft_features.name: Write Leveling (MR1 A7=1)
exposed_dft_features.purpose: DRAM asynchronously samples CK / CK# on the rising DQS edge and feeds back the sampled value on DQ — controller uses it to align DQS-to-CK on fly-by DIMMs.

exposed_dft_features.name: ZQ Calibration (ZQCL / ZQCS)
exposed_dft_features.purpose: On-die calibration engine trims output driver Ron and ODT Rtt against an external 240 Ω reference.

exposed_dft_features.name: Test Mode (MR0 A7=1)
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Vendor-reserved DRAM manufacturer test mode. Not for normal use (behaviour undefined to users).

exposed_dft_features.name: Qoff (MR1 A12=1)
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Disables all output buffers (DQ / DQS / DQS#) without disabling the rest of the DRAM — used for module-level IDD measurements.

exposed_dft_features.name: IDD measurement points (Section 10)
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Defined per-state IDD specifications (IDD0..IDD7) at known sequences allow per-state power characterization.

fields.no_jtag_on_DRAM_balls: DDR3 SDRAM has no JTAG / boundary-scan / scan-shift pins at the package interface. Vendor scan / BIST runs at wafer-probe time and is not accessible in the field.
controller_side_dft_aids: Per-byte-lane PHY observability: DDR3 PHY IP typically exposes RX FIFO contents, calibration FSM state, eye margin sweep, per-bit deskew settings via a control register interface (vendor-specific).
Logic-analyzer / oscilloscope probing of CK / CK# / CKE / CS# / RAS# / CAS# / WE# / DQ / DQS / DQS# / DM / ODT on the DIMM edge or board-level test points.
ECC (SEC-DED) at the system level on x8 ECC ranks — detects single-bit errors and corrects them, doubles as a DRAM defect / soft-error indicator.
MPR predefined pattern as a deterministic read self-test pattern through the PHY.
fields.notes: DDR3 SDRAM does not specify a formal in-system scan / JTAG architecture. The bus-level DFT features are limited to MPR (read training), Write Leveling (write training), ZQ calibration (impedance trim), and the optional vendor test mode. Internal DRAM die scan, BIST, redundancy-row repair, and wafer-level burn-in are vendor-proprietary.
